from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,math
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
ROOT=Path.cwd()
OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_fixed_score_price_response_timing_v1'
PRIOR=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1'
if (OUT/'result.json').exists():raise RuntimeError('固定诊断已有结果，禁止重跑或选新窗口。')
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def clean(x):
    if isinstance(x,dict):return {str(k):clean(v) for k,v in x.items()}
    if isinstance(x,(list,tuple)):return [clean(v) for v in x]
    if isinstance(x,(datetime,pd.Timestamp)):return x.isoformat()
    if isinstance(x,(np.integer,np.floating,np.bool_)):return clean(x.item())
    if isinstance(x,float) and not math.isfinite(x):return None
    return x
def save(name,obj):
    p=OUT/name
    if p.exists():raise RuntimeError('禁止覆盖研究结果：'+name)
    p.write_text(json.dumps(clean(obj),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
protocol=json.loads((OUT/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
for spec in protocol['parents']:assert sha(ROOT/spec['path'])==spec['sha256'],'父源变化'
d=pd.read_parquet(PRIOR/'纠错八变量历史输入及原标签.parquet')
d10=pd.read_parquet(PRIOR/'纠错十变量历史输入及原标签.parquet')
assert d10[d.columns].equals(d)
p8=pd.read_csv(PRIOR/'纠错8变量每日联合评分.csv')
p10=pd.read_csv(PRIOR/'纠错10变量每日联合评分.csv')
for p in [p8,p10]:p['date']=pd.to_datetime(p.date)
assert p8.idx.equals(p10.idx) and p8.date.equals(p10.date)
assert len(p8)==1212 and int(p8.era.eq('2024—2025').sum())==485
i=p8.idx.to_numpy(int)
assert np.array_equal(i,d.idx.iloc[i].to_numpy(int))
assert np.array_equal(p8.date.to_numpy(dtype='datetime64[ns]'),d.date.iloc[i].to_numpy(dtype='datetime64[ns]'))
assert np.isfinite(d.loc[i,'net_label']).all()
assert np.allclose(p8.actual_net5,d.loc[i,'net_label'],rtol=0,atol=1e-12)
assert np.allclose(p10.actual_net5,p8.actual_net5,rtol=0,atol=1e-12)
w=d.wealth.to_numpy(float)
o=d.open.to_numpy(float)
c=d.close.to_numpy(float)
div=d.dividend.to_numpy(float)
daily=d.total_simple.to_numpy(float)
overnight=d.overnight_log.to_numpy(float)
phases=pd.DataFrame({'idx':i,'signal_date':d.date.iloc[i].to_numpy(),'next_open_date':d.date.iloc[i+1].to_numpy(),'pre20_start_date':d.date.iloc[i-20].to_numpy(),'pre20_total_return':w[i]/w[i-20]-1,'pre19_before_signal_total_return':w[i-1]/w[i-20]-1,'signal_day_total_return':daily[i],'signal_close':c[i],'next_open':o[i+1],'next_ex_distribution':div[i+1],'raw_next_open_quote_gap':o[i+1]/c[i]-1,'dividend_aligned_next_open_gap':(o[i+1]+div[i+1])/c[i]-1})
pre_identity=(1+phases.pre19_before_signal_total_return)*(1+phases.signal_day_total_return)-1-phases.pre20_total_return
gap_identity=np.expm1(overnight[i+1])-phases.dividend_aligned_next_open_gap
assert np.max(np.abs(pre_identity))<1e-10
assert np.max(np.abs(gap_identity))<1e-10
measurements=['pre20_total_return','pre19_before_signal_total_return','signal_day_total_return','raw_next_open_quote_gap','dividend_aligned_next_open_gap','actual_net5','nonlinear_prediction']
frames=[]
for size,p in [(8,p8),(10,p10)]:
    assert np.minimum((p.score/20).astype(int),4).equals(p.score_bin)
    joined=p.merge(phases,on='idx',how='left',validate='one_to_one')
    assert np.array_equal(joined.date.to_numpy(dtype='datetime64[ns]'),pd.to_datetime(joined.signal_date).to_numpy(dtype='datetime64[ns]'))
    joined['features']=size
    joined['diagnostic_only']=True
    joined['next_open_gap_not_known_at_signal']=True
    frames.append(joined)
all_days=pd.concat(frames,ignore_index=True)
all_days.to_csv(OUT/'全部原评分日价格时段绑定.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
all_days.to_parquet(OUT/'全部原评分日价格时段绑定.parquet',index=False)

def describe(block):
    result={'n':len(block)}
    for col in measurements:
        values=block[col].dropna()
        result[col+'_mean']=float(values.mean())
        result[col+'_median']=float(values.median())
        result[col+'_positive_count']=int(values.gt(0).sum())
        result[col+'_valid_count']=len(values)
    return result
buckets=[]
for size in [8,10]:
    for era in ['2021—2023','2024—2025']:
        period=all_days[all_days.features.eq(size)&all_days.era.eq(era)]
        for band in range(5):
            block=period[period.score_bin.eq(band)]
            buckets.append({'features':size,'era':era,'score_band':str(20*band)+'—'+str(20*(band+1)),**describe(block)})
pd.DataFrame(buckets).to_csv(OUT/'原五分档全部价格时段.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
original_events=pd.read_csv(PRIOR/'固定高分不重叠机会.csv')
chosen=original_events[original_events.version.eq('同参数纠错')].copy()
chosen=chosen.rename(columns={'signal_idx':'idx'})
joined_events=chosen.merge(all_days[['idx','features']+[col for col in phases.columns if col!='idx']+['actual_net5','nonlinear_prediction']],on=['idx','features'],how='left',validate='one_to_one',suffixes=('_event',''))
assert len(joined_events)==len(chosen)==70
assert np.allclose(joined_events.net_event_return,joined_events.actual_net5,rtol=0,atol=1e-12)
assert np.allclose(joined_events.prediction,joined_events.nonlinear_prediction,rtol=0,atol=1e-12)
assert np.isfinite(joined_events[measurements].to_numpy(float)).all()
event_summaries=[]
for size in [8,10]:
    for era in ['2021—2023','2024—2025']:
        block=joined_events[joined_events.features.eq(size)&joined_events.era.eq(era)]
        if era=='2024—2025':assert len(block)==9
        else:assert len(block)==26
        event_summaries.append({'features':size,'era':era,**describe(block)})
joined_events.to_csv(OUT/'全部固定自然机会价格时段.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
pd.DataFrame(event_summaries).to_csv(OUT/'固定自然机会价格时段摘要.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
main=joined_events[joined_events.era.eq('2024—2025')].copy()
main.to_csv(OUT/'主期全部9机会_两个模型保留.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
main8=main[main.features.eq(8)].sort_values('idx').reset_index(drop=True)
main10=main[main.features.eq(10)].sort_values('idx').reset_index(drop=True)
assert main8.idx.equals(main10.idx)
hypothesis=[]
for item in [s for s in event_summaries if s['era']=='2024—2025']:
    pattern=item['pre20_total_return_mean']>0 and item['actual_net5_mean']<=0
    hypothesis.append({'features':item['features'],'n':item['n'],'pre20_mean':item['pre20_total_return_mean'],'net5_mean':item['actual_net5_mean'],'pre20_positive_count':item['pre20_total_return_positive_count'],'signal_day_mean':item['signal_day_total_return_mean'],'next_open_aligned_gap_mean':item['dividend_aligned_next_open_gap_mean'],'fixed_before_positive_after_nonpositive_pattern_supported':bool(pattern),'causal_full_information_absorption':'NOT_IDENTIFIED','earlier_entry_advantage':'NOT_TESTED_NOT_AUTHORIZED'})
supported=all(h['fixed_before_positive_after_nonpositive_pattern_supported'] for h in hypothesis)
status='COMPLETED_FIXED_TIMING_BEFORE_POSITIVE_AFTER_NONPOSITIVE_PATTERN_ONLY' if supported else 'COMPLETED_FIXED_TIMING_SIMPLE_PRE_SIGNAL_RALLY_STORY_NOT_SUPPORTED'
for spec in protocol['parents']:assert sha(ROOT/spec['path'])==spec['sha256']
save('保存结果必要核对.json',{'status':'PASS_FROZEN_SCORE_EVENT_POOL_AND_PHASE_IDENTITIES','checked_at':now(),'parents_unchanged':len(protocol['parents']),'scoring_rows':2424,'primary_rows':970,'five_band_summary_rows':20,'natural_events':70,'primary_natural_events_per_model':9,'maximum_past_total_return_compound_identity_error':float(np.max(np.abs(pre_identity))),'maximum_ex_distribution_overnight_identity_error':float(np.max(np.abs(gap_identity))),'same_original_labels_and_predictions':True,'eight_ten_same_price_inputs':True,'all_original_five_bands_retained':True,'new_source_acquisitions':0,'new_labels':0,'new_fits':0,'new_full_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0})
result={'study_id':protocol['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E22','completed_at':now(),'status':status,'classification':'PROGRESS_E22_FIXED_PRICE_TIMING_FACTS_COMPLETED_HYPOTHESIS_ADJUDICATED','previous_goal_turn_classification':protocol['previous_goal_turn_classification'],'source_parents':len(protocol['parents']),'score_days_per_model':1212,'primary_score_days_per_model':485,'all_original_five_bands':buckets,'all_natural_event_summaries':event_summaries,'primary_hypothesis':hypothesis,'main_model_event_dates_identical':True,'new_source_acquisitions':0,'new_labels':0,'new_fits':0,'new_full_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,'parameter_grids':0,'net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','goal_achieved':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','orders_authorized':False,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'causal_information_absorption':'NOT_IDENTIFIED','price_gap_is_ex_post_diagnostic_not_signal':True,'historical_not_independent_validation':True,'facts_report':OUT.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()+'/固定高分价格时段_研究结论.md'}
save('result.json',result)
lines=['# E22：固定高分的价格反应发生在什么时段','','本轮复用E21纠错后原分数和五日成本标签，只做原时段解释。主期2024—2025全部485日、五分档和两模型各9笔自然机会均保留；无新增模型、来源、收益标签或账户。','','| 模型 | 主期机会 | 信号前20日平均总回报（含信号日） | 信号日平均总回报 | 除息对齐次日开盘缺口 | 原可成交五日平均净收益 |','|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|']
for h in hypothesis:
    lines.append('| '+str(h['features'])+'变量 | '+str(h['n'])+' | '+format(h['pre20_mean']*100,'.6f')+'% | '+format(h['signal_day_mean']*100,'.6f')+'% | '+format(h['next_open_aligned_gap_mean']*100,'.6f')+'% | '+format(h['net5_mean']*100,'.6f')+'% |')
lines+=['','原登记的简单先涨后无净收益模式：'+('在固定主期池中成立；仅接受时段事实。' if supported else '不成立；不能把该评分失败简单解释为此前已经上涨。'),'','两模型主期机会日期相同。信号日已包含在20日总回报中，两者不能直接相加；19日分量仅用于复利恒等式核对。次日开盘缺口是事后价格段，不能作为原16点信号输入；除息对齐描述既有持有人权益，不声称次日新买者可取得这项股息。','','时间先后不能独自证明完全信息吸收或上游经济因果，也不能证明提前买入会盈利。九笔机会和重叠日标签只支持限定历史诊断，不能改方向、窗口、退出或反向交易来救原失败。完整账户及夏普未计算，目标未完成。','','逐笔主期八变量机会：','','| 信号日 | 前20日总回报 | 信号日总回报 | 次日除息对齐缺口 | 原五日净收益 |','|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|']
for row in main8.itertuples(index=False):
    lines.append('| '+str(row.signal_date)[:10]+' | '+format(row.pre20_total_return*100,'.4f')+'% | '+format(row.signal_day_total_return*100,'.4f')+'% | '+format(row.dividend_aligned_next_open_gap*100,'.4f')+'% | '+format(row.actual_net5*100,'.4f')+'% |')
lines+=['','[全部原五档](原五分档全部价格时段.csv)、[全部自然机会](全部固定自然机会价格时段.csv)、[结果](result.json)、[必要核对](保存结果必要核对.json)。']
(OUT/'固定高分价格时段_研究结论.md').write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(clean({'状态':status,'主期原假设':hypothesis,'全部原分档':20,'新拟合':0,'新账户':0,'目标':False}),ensure_ascii=False))
